text: Our origins are of the earth. And so there is in us a deeply seated response to the natural universe, which is part of our humanity.
author: Rachel Carson
visual_brief: An industrial design concept sketch of a palm-sized botanical incubator, rendered in fine white linework on black. Construction lines and faint radial callouts show a central glass droplet cradled within ribbed ceramic tongs, with subtle directional arrows indicating the gentle hinge motion opening to release a sprouted seed.
alt: Design sketch of a delicate hand-held glass and ceramic seed incubator
